name: zsys_read_cmos_rtc_seconds_bcd
description: zSys::ReadCmosRtcSecondsBcd returns a BCD-encoded seconds value. The VC5 profile selects CMOS register 0 and reads port 0x71 through CRT port I/O intrinsics like retail.
known_limits: The native smoke verifies that the returned value is a valid BCD seconds byte.
Modern smoke builds use a GetTickCount-based BCD fallback because user-mode port I/O would fault outside the VC5 verification profile.
